subject.title: Feature Request: Add Skill Priority Configuration

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class user-configurable skill ordering/priority contract, and should that contract live in the existing skills config rather than a new sidecar file?
rationale: The request is implementable, but it changes canonical config and model-visible prompt ordering, so automation should not choose priority semantics or storage shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve canonical config ordering
options.body: Add a supported priority/order field under the existing skills config, with deterministic fallback order, CLI inspection/management, docs, tests, and snapshot invalidation.

options.title: Use existing allowlists and truncation work
options.body: Decline global priority for now and steer users to per-agent skill allowlists plus the narrower truncation-visibility work.

options.title: Defer to broader smart indexing
options.body: Keep this issue as blocked on a larger skill search/indexing direction such as category-aware lazy loading.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical config ordering
recommendation.body: Add a supported priority/order field under the existing skills config, with deterministic fallback order, CLI inspection/management, docs, tests, and snapshot invalidation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current history across skills CLI, skill config, and the current moved skills-loading files.
